stories.title: 'La fucilazione dell'autore della strage di Fort Hood sarà in diretta streaming'

en.title: The execution of Fort Hood massacre perpetrator will be livestreamed
en.summary: A Pentagon official confirmed that the execution will be broadcast online, according to American media reports.

stories.title: Sindacati, da lunedì sciopero nazionale all'ex Ilva per 24 ore

en.title: Unions announce 24-hour national strike at former Ilva starting Monday
en.summary: Union representatives declared a nationwide strike at the former Ilva facility following discussions at the Prime Minister's office.

stories.title: Hegseth, la fucilazione dell'autore della strage di Fort Hood sarà pubblica

en.title: Hegseth: Fort Hood massacre perpetrator execution will be public
en.summary: The execution would mark the first public execution in 90 years, according to statements from the official.

stories.title: Strage di Fort Hood, la fucilazione di Nidal Hasan sarà trasmessa in streaming

en.title: Fort Hood massacre: Nidal Hasan's execution will be streamed
en.summary: Former Army Major and psychiatrist Nidal Hasan, sentenced to death for a 2009 Texas shooting, will be executed by firing squad on December 3rd at the military base.

stories.title: 'Negoziatori Kiev domani a Miami, invitati Gb, Francia, Germania, Nato e Ue

en.title: Kiev negotiators heading to Miami tomorrow, UK, France, Germany, NATO and EU invited
en.summary: Ukrainian negotiators are traveling to Miami for discussions that will include representatives from the UK, France, Germany, NATO, and the EU. The talks will reportedly focus on new U.S. proposals.

stories.title: Raid russo su due autobus a Kramatorsk, 33 morti. Zelensky: “L’attacco non resterà senza risposta”

en.title: Russian strike on two buses in Kramatorsk kills 33. Zelensky: 'Attack will not go unanswered'
en.summary: A Russian attack on buses in Kramatorsk resulted in 33 deaths, prompting a statement from Zelensky about retaliation. Ukrainian negotiators are scheduled to meet with U.S. officials in Miami, while a Russian oil refinery in Omsk was also targeted.

stories.title: Legge elettorale, il centrosinistra: "Una truffa, cambiate le regole perché avete paura"

en.title: Electoral law: center-left says 'It's a fraud, change the rules because you're afraid'
en.summary: Opposition parties are announcing constitutional court challenges to the electoral law. Political leaders accused the government of changing rules out of fear and lack of ideas.

stories.title: Ex Ilva: Acciaierie d'Italia annuncia fermata temporanea Genova e Novi Ligure

en.title: Ex Ilva: Acciaierie d'Italia announces temporary shutdown in Genova and Novi Ligure
en.summary: Acciaierie d'Italia announced a temporary halt of operations at its facilities in Genova and Novi Ligure. Local mayors criticized the decision as unacceptable.

stories.title: Aggressione a Iacopini, caccia alla banda della minicar nera: quattro casi simili nel raggio di 3 km

en.title: Attack on Iacopini, hunt for black minivan gang: four similar cases within 3 km radius
en.summary: Investigations continue into an assault on Iacopini with authorities pursuing suspects linked to a black minivan. Similar incidents have occurred in the Monteverde area within a small geographic radius.

stories.title: Ex Ilva, i sindacati proclamano sciopero di 24 ore lunedì dopo l’annuncio dello stop a Genova e Novi

en.title: Ex Ilva, unions call 24-hour strike on Monday following announcement of Genova and Novi shutdown
en.summary: Production at the Genova and Novi facilities is set to halt by November 15. Union leaders have declared this decision unacceptable for workers, the affected cities, and Italy's steel industry.

stories.title: Nobel per la Letteratura 2026 alla poetessa canadese Anne Carson

en.title: Nobel Prize for Literature 2026 awarded to Canadian poet Anne Carson
en.summary: Anne Carson received the award for her bold and innovative body of work that creates new forms for contemporary literature through playful dialogue with classical tradition, worth approximately 1.2 million dollars.

stories.title: Legge elettorale, ora il Melonellum: cosa cambia per gli italiani e come si voterà

en.title: Electoral law, now the Melonellum: what changes for Italians and how voting will work
en.summary: Parliament approved a new electoral reform with 227 votes in favor and 164 against. The reform replaces the previous system with a proportional system including a majority bonus, preference voting, and premier candidate indication.

stories.title: Brand globali dall’anima locale, la nuova partita si gioca sotto casa

en.title: Global brands with local soul, the new competition plays out in your backyard
en.summary: International brands are increasingly competing in local markets through localized strategies. The comparison suggests this competitive dynamic resembles regional rivalries, with examples from major cities worldwide.

stories.title: Aerospazio, dal business satellitare spinta ai progetti hi tech

en.title: Aerospace, satellite business drives high-tech projects
en.summary: Italy's aerospace sector needs to strengthen its competitive position in Europe and globally through coordinated effort between companies and institutions, according to Sitael's CEO Chiara Pertosa.

stories.title: Energy Dome, la batteria alla CO2 fatta a Piacenza

en.title: Energy Dome, the CO2 battery made in Piacenza
en.summary: Energy Dome has officially opened a manufacturing facility in Piacenza producing large domes containing compressed CO2 as part of its proprietary energy storage system called CO2 Battery.

stories.title: Intesa Sanpaolo stanzia 20 miliardi per le piccole imprese

en.title: Intesa Sanpaolo allocates 20 billion for small businesses
en.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo has announced a 20 billion euro initiative through its Territorial Banking Division to support small and medium-sized enterprises in the tertiary sector.

stories.title: La classifica delle migliori aziende dove lavorare: nella top 100 Chiesi e Bending Spoons

en.title: Ranking of best companies to work for: Chiesi and Bending Spoons in top 100
en.summary: Hilton leads the Great Place to Work ranking, followed by AbbVie and DHL. The top-performing sectors include IT, financial services, insurance, and professional services.
